description:
Run `jit recover`'s lease eviction and stale-lease reclaim through the held lease lock, so recovery changes leases the same way every other operation does. The lock cannot be taken inside a retained repository session, so recover becomes a claims-first command.

## Background

The claims family's recover operation repairs derived state, cleans stale locks, verifies and rebuilds the index from the log, then evicts expired leases by hand in its git phase (`load_claims_index`, `evict_expired`, `write_index_atomic`). The recovery reclaim change 5b37a806 adds a pass that reclaims indefinite leases whose heartbeat lapsed. Today's lease pass takes neither guard nor lock.

`jit recover` runs inside a retained session: `Commands::Recover` is not claims-first and requires recovery dispatch (`cli.rs`), so `open_repository` (`commands/bootstrap.rs`) retains its session, which holds `RepositoryOrderGuard`, and `CoordinationOrderGuard::enter` (`storage/guard_order.rs`) refuses inside it. A claims-first command opens its startup session, reports what it recovered and drops it before coordinating, so moving recover there lets a `LeaseLock` be taken.

`open_repository` maps a leftover-record failure to `RecoveryFailedError` when `is_recover` is set, in the retaining arm only, and a test in `commands/bootstrap.rs` pins that mapping. `CLAIM_FIRST_LEAF_COMMANDS` and `test_claim_first_classification_covers_exact_cli_callers` (`cli.rs`) pin the classification. `ClaimCoordinator::lock()` returns a `LeaseLock` with `list` and `apply`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Commands::Recover` is claims-first, `recover` is listed in `CLAIM_FIRST_LEAF_COMMANDS`, and its startup session is opened and dropped before any lease pass.
- [hard] REQ-02: A leftover-record failure of `jit recover`'s session open still surfaces as `RecoveryFailedError`, and the test in `commands/bootstrap.rs` still proves it; another command still reports the session-open failure itself.
- [hard] REQ-03: `jit recover` evicts expired leases and reclaims stale indefinite leases under one `LeaseLock`, through `list()` and `apply`, and reports both counts.
- [hard] REQ-04: Recovery's existing tests pass, and a test shows that an expired lease and a stale indefinite lease are both removed and logged once.
title: Recovery evicts and reclaims leases through the lease lock
